drug_class: Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitor
notes: Gefitinib is primarily available in the 250 mg strength in the US market. The 250 mg dose is the standard therapeutic dose for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) treatment. Limited generic competition exists in the US market. Appearance may vary slightly between manufacturers but all are film-coated round tablets. No lower-strength variants (such as 125 mg) are currently marketed in the US.
